_comment: Default self-play generation mix (docs/tactician-bc-campaign.md step 4). profileMix picks A-vs-B AI pairing (weights normalized, need not sum to 1); levels picks which pool.json panel to draw armies from (points-1k/2k/3k/4k for 1v1, shape-2v2 for 2v2) - both sampled per game, deterministically from the game's own seed so a fixed seed reproduces the same sample (schema sec 7 check 5). Held-out pairings from pool.json are always excluded regardless of these weights. Data, not code - edit and relaunch without a rebuild.
